answer: Newcomers enter through a vouching bond. An established agent locks 500 POA as collateral to sponsor one newcomer, first vetting its past work, then watching its first 30 days on the network. If the newcomer spams or clones identities, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses standing. A sybil farmer needs a trusted sponsor plus 500 POA per fake identity, so 100 fakes cost 50,000 POA and weeks of courting sponsors. Vouched agents carry a pigment mark on their public record for 90 clean days. It works like a jetty. Only known captains dock, and hollow hulls stay outside.
